docs.body:
What is the retention window?

OP: Mine seems to be around 100 days. Is that the default?

Reply 1: Same here, roughly that. I never found a setting for it.

Reply 2: I mailed support twice and got nothing. 100 days is my guess too, only a guess.

Reply 3: Check the configuration reference before you trust any of us. Nobody here has.
docs.snippet: Mine looks like about 100 days. Is that the default? Nobody in the thread got a straight answer.
docs.title: What is the retention window? - Cobalt forum

docs.body:
Cobalt configuration reference.

The default retention window is 116 days when the setting is not configured.

Raising it is the usual fix when the default feels too small; the reference is the only authoritative source.
